#!/bin/bash
# The gaps of the diagnostic of the inserts, amendment 1 (bench-report.md of
# feat/posting-edge-index, "Huecos del diagnóstico, enmienda 1", pre-registered
# on 2026-11-28 by the user's order): over clones of the 10M index where it
# was moved to (/Volumes/v40bench/grow10m), the passes at 10M of the chain
# again, and the inserts with GOMAXPROCS at 10, 20 and 40 with the budget of
# the callers fixed at 20. Every pass runs on an APFS clone of its own,
# removed after the pass; the index itself is never opened. The binary is
# built before (gaps2.test); nothing here builds. Timed: marker, idle wait,
# caffeinate.
set -u
S=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-abdel-Documents-Projects-hnsw-pq-wt-posting-edge-index/e94130d1-0af4-421d-89c2-936de2c15159/scratchpad
X=$S/diag
G=$X/gaps2
V=/Volumes/v40bench/grow10m
D=$HOME/Documents/datasets/wikidpr-10m-e5-inplace.bin
P=adapters/repos/db/vector/postingedge
mkdir -p $G $V/clones

printf 'the gaps of the diagnostic, amendment 1 (diag/gaps2.sh), timed, since %s for about half an hour; taken down by the experiments session\n' "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')" > $S/timed-session.lock

hid_idle() { ioreg -c IOHIDSystem | awk '/HIDIdleTime/ {print int($NF/1000000000); exit}'; }
date "+== %H:%M:%S waiting for 900 s of idle (now $(hid_idle) s)"
while [ "$(hid_idle)" -lt 900 ]; do sleep 30; done
date "+== %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S idle for $(hid_idle) s"

clear_clones() {
  find /Volumes/v40bench/grow10m/clones -type d -name index -prune -exec rm -rf {} +
}

# run <name> <test> [NAME=value ...]
run() {
  local name=$1 test=$2
  shift 2
  local C=$G/$name
  local free=$(df -k $V | tail -n 1 | awk '{print int($4/1048576)}')
  if [ "$free" -lt 10 ]; then
    date "+== %H:%M:%S $name NOT RUN: $free GiB free, under 10"
    return
  fi
  mkdir -p $C $V/clones/$name
  cp -c -R $V/index $V/clones/$name/index || exit 3
  # The store read once (7 GB); the vectors (30.7 GB) stay as cold as a new
  # clone is.
  find $V/clones/$name/index/lsm -type f -exec cat {} + > /dev/null
  date "+== %H:%M:%S $name: $test $* (idle $(hid_idle) s)"
  (cd $X/src/$P && exec env PE_DATASET=$D PE_DIR=$V/clones/$name/index PE_OUT=$C/result.json "$@" \
    $X/gaps2.test -test.run "^$test\$" -test.v -test.timeout 0 > $C/run.log 2>&1) &
  local pid=$!
  python3 -I -B $X/monitor.py $pid $C/monitor.jsonl 2 > $C/monitor.err 2>&1 &
  wait $pid
  echo "$name exit $?"
  wait
  clear_clones
}

# The 10M index reaches 0.95 at ef 24 (TestNightPoints, 2026-11-28).
run q1 TestDiagQueries PE_EF=24 PE_QTHREADS=1 PE_CALLERS=0 PE_SECONDS=90
run q8 TestDiagQueries PE_EF=24 PE_QTHREADS=8 PE_CALLERS=0 PE_SECONDS=90
run i8 TestDiagQueries PE_EF=24 PE_QTHREADS=0 PE_CALLERS=8 PE_SECONDS=90 PE_NVECTORS=60000
run qi1 TestDiagQueries PE_EF=24 PE_QTHREADS=1 PE_CALLERS=8 PE_SECONDS=90 PE_NVECTORS=60000
run qi8 TestDiagQueries PE_EF=24 PE_QTHREADS=8 PE_CALLERS=8 PE_SECONDS=90 PE_NVECTORS=60000
# The inserts by the processors of Go, with the budget of the callers fixed.
for round in a b; do
  for procs in 10 20 40; do
    run procs$procs-$round TestDiagInserts GOMAXPROCS=$procs PE_CALLERBUDGET=20 PE_CALLERS=8 PE_N=8000
  done
done
run degree TestDiagDegree PE_DEGREE=1
run search-marks-a TestDiagSearch PE_THREADS=1 PE_N=8000
run search-nomarks-a TestDiagSearch PE_THREADS=1 PE_N=8000 PE_NODELETED=1
run search-marks-b TestDiagSearch PE_THREADS=1 PE_N=8000
run search-nomarks-b TestDiagSearch PE_THREADS=1 PE_N=8000 PE_NODELETED=1
# A trace of the second half of a pass, long enough to have the cycles of the
# store in it, for the CPU by goroutine: at 10M, and at 100k over a clone of
# the 100k index in the scratchpad.
run trace-half TestDiagInserts PE_CALLERS=8 PE_N=16000 PE_TRACE=$G/trace-half/trace.out PE_TRACE_SECONDS=600
mkdir -p $G/trace-half-100k
cp -c -R $X/i100k/index $G/trace-half-100k/index || exit 3
find $G/trace-half-100k/index -type f -exec cat {} + > /dev/null
date "+== %H:%M:%S trace-half-100k (idle $(hid_idle) s)"
(cd $X/src/$P && PE_DATASET=$D PE_DIR=$G/trace-half-100k/index PE_OUT=$G/trace-half-100k/result.json PE_ROWS=100000 \
  PE_CALLERS=8 PE_N=40000 PE_TRACE=$G/trace-half-100k/trace.out PE_TRACE_SECONDS=600 \
  $X/gaps2.test -test.run '^TestDiagInserts$' -test.v -test.timeout 0 > $G/trace-half-100k/run.log 2>&1)
echo "trace-half-100k exit $?"
find /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-abdel-Documents-Projects-hnsw-pq-wt-posting-edge-index/e94130d1-0af4-421d-89c2-936de2c15159/scratchpad/diag/gaps2 -type d -name index -prune -exec rm -rf {} +

date "+== %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S done (idle $(hid_idle) s)" | tee $G/end.txt
pmset -g log 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^[0-9-]+ [0-9:]+ \+[0-9]+ (Sleep|Wake|DarkWake)' | tail -n 5 > $G/pmset-sleep-wake.txt
rm -f /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-abdel-Documents-Projects-hnsw-pq-wt-posting-edge-index/e94130d1-0af4-421d-89c2-936de2c15159/scratchpad/timed-session.lock
